purpose: AI-generated 2D hand-drawn workflow diagrams for repository documentation. These are explanatory diagrams, not screenshots or evidence of execution.

assets.title: Account, runner and spending authority
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create one polished 2D hand-drawn technical workflow diagram for the Obolos GitHub README. Wide landscape canvas, about 1800 by 1100 pixels. Cream background #faf8f2, black ink outlines with a subtle hand-drawn wobble, flat pale lavender and coral fills, small sage accents. NO shadows, NO gradients, NO perspective, NO 3D, NO textures, NO decorative characters. Use spacious rectangular node boxes, occasional decision diamonds only where specified, and carefully routed arrows with visible arrowheads. Like a meticulously drawn engineering notebook, not a poster or metaphorical illustration. All labels must be very legible, short, and spelled exactly. Use neat hand-lettered sans-serif text, strong hierarchy, generous margins. Every workflow has a large title and smaller subtitle; no footer branding or extra claims. Do not invent nodes, connections or captions. Use the exact specified arrow directions. Distinguish separate flows with labeled lanes. Avoid crossing connectors or arrows through boxes. Accuracy matters more than decoration.
Title: "Account, runner and spending authority"
Subtitle: "Identity, credentials and payment permission are separate"
Diagram with three horizontal lanes.
Top lane "PUBLIC WORKSPACE": "Owner wallet" → "Sign in" → "Create agent" → "Scoped API key".
Middle lane "PRIVATE HOST": "Scoped API key" from above → "Configure runner". Separate small box "Ledger Key Ring" points to Configure runner with arrow label "Private credentials". Configure runner → "Ready to plan".
Bottom lane "PAYMENT AUTHORITY": "Ledger controller" → "Signed mandate" → "On-chain limits". Separate box "Funded Circle wallet".
Both "On-chain limits" and "Funded Circle wallet" point to a final box at lower right "Authorized execution". "Ready to plan" points to that final box with arrow label "Approved task plan".
Place two concise notes at bottom: "Sign-in and API keys cannot raise spending limits." and "Ledger device: Speculos emulation. Circle signs Arc payments."
Do not imply that Ledger signs Circle transactions. All arrows must make the distinct requirements clear.

Title: "From a task to paid service calls"
Subtitle: "The model proposes. The owner approves. The runner executes."
Use three left-to-right lanes with clear downward connectors at the right edge or separate routing gutters.
Lane "PLAN": "Task + budget" → "Queued task" → "Private planner" → "Fixed service plan". A box "Published catalog" above points only to Private planner. A branch from Private planner labeled "Unsupported" leads to "Blocked before payment".

revisionPrompts: Edit this diagram with ONE precise connector correction. Keep all existing boxes, labels, typography, layout, color and other arrows unchanged. DELETE the vertical arrow from 'Validate current limits' into 'Pay + call service 2'. REPLACE it with a routed elbow arrow: start at the bottom center of 'Validate current limits', move down into the white gutter above the EXECUTE lane, run LEFT across that gutter until above the center of 'Pay + call service 1', then point DOWN into the TOP border of 'Pay + call service 1'. It must connect to SERVICE 1, never service 2. Preserve the left-to-right execution chain service 1 → Actual output → service 2 → Results + receipts. No other changes. Flat 2D, no shadows.

Title: "Arc payment, delivery and acknowledgment"
Subtitle: "Three distinct records for one durable order"
Four clear horizontal lanes, nodes connected in actual execution order.
Lane "BUYER": "Check policy + exact terms" → "Persist order journal" → "Circle payment".
Lane "ARC": Circle payment → "Finalized settlement". Finalized settlement branches to three small boxes "95% seller", "3% reserve", "2% review pool". Separate outgoing connector from Finalized settlement leads to next lane "Verify exact receipt".
Lane "PROVIDER": "Verify exact receipt" → "Execute paid request" → "Return output + hash" → "Seller delivery attestation".
Lane "BUYER": "Validate output + attestation" → "Buyer acknowledgment" → "App results + receipts". Arrow from Seller delivery attestation to Validate output + attestation. The full returned output is also an input to that validation.
Use small circled markers 1 beside Finalized settlement, 2 beside Seller delivery attestation, 3 beside Buyer acknowledgment.
Bottom note: "Payment is not delivery. Acknowledgment is not independent proof of usefulness." No escrow or bridge.
revisionPrompts: Edit this diagram with ONE precise connector correction. Keep every existing node, all text, allocation branches, and other connectors exactly as is. DELETE the vertical arrow from 'Finalized settlement' down to 'Return output + hash'. REPLACE it with one routed elbow arrow from the bottom center of 'Finalized settlement' down into the white gutter above the PROVIDER lane, LEFT along that gutter to above 'Verify exact receipt', then DOWN into the top border of 'Verify exact receipt'. Payment MUST flow into receipt verification first, then execution, then output. No shortcut arrow from settlement directly to output. Preserve the two separate output/attestation inputs into buyer validation. Flat 2D hand-drawn, no shadows.

Change exactly ONE node label in this otherwise correct diagram: replace 'Return output + hash' with 'Produce output + hash'. Keep its box, all connectors, every other label, all positions and style unchanged. This distinction means the provider produces the output before attesting, and the buyer validates both the returned output and the attestation. Do not change any arrow. No shadows, no 3D.

Title: "Recover safely. Record refunds honestly."
Subtitle: "Keep the original order and payment identity"
Three distinct horizontal rows with no arrows between rows.
Row "UNCERTAIN PAYMENT": "Saved payment journal" → "Query original transaction" → decision diamond "Confirmed?". Yes → "Verify receipt". No or unknown → "Stop for reconciliation". Note below this row: "Never create a replacement payment while the outcome is uncertain."
Row "DELIVERY RETRY": "Already-paid order" → "Retry same order ID" → "Cached or recovered output" → "Verify original hashes". Note: "Delivery retry does not pay again."
Row "VOLUNTARY REFUND": "Buyer records dispute" → "Seller chooses refund" → "Seller transfers to payer" → "Verify finalized transfer" → "Record refund evidence". Tiny sublabel under verification: "Amount, sender, recipient, uniqueness".
Bottom note: "No escrow arbitration. A dispute does not automatically move funds." All rows visually independent and clearly separated.
